name: Coffee Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Coffee Mahjong is one of the best games to play in the morning. It has a fun twist on your regular mahjong game with its coffee-themed layout. It also has a chill and relaxing tune that will help you start your day. This is an amusing tile-matching game with 17 levels of a variety of difficulty. Each tile is decorated with a different java-related image like iced coffee, coffee beans, and pastries. It’s perfect for your early morning wake-up game. Once you’ve played, you can also submit your score to see how well you did against other players.
